name: Pit Wall
intro: You will play in Pit Wall’s pretend league (Alex, Bea, Cal, Dana and Eli): post some trash talk in the Paddock, then act as the commissioner to add a player and rename the league. The race dates and points on the screen come from the real F1 season and change every weekend, so this test never asks you to check them.

steps.do: Look at the welcome card at the bottom (“Welcome to Pit Wall”). Tap the small words “skip the tour” at its bottom right.
steps.see: A card asks “How do you want to start?” with two choices: “🧪 Keep the examples to play with” and “✨ Start fresh with my own”.
steps.tip: A green greeting strip may also show at the top (for example “Good morning.”). Tap its ✕ if it is in the way.

steps.do: Tap “🧪 Keep the examples to play with”.
steps.see: The home page. Under the title it says “PRETEND LEAGUE · 2026 · THIS DEVICE ONLY”, a gold note says “🎭 This is a pretend league — set up your own in Setup.”, and the top-right button says “Who are you?”.

steps.do: Scroll down to “TEST DRIVE · ACT AS” and tap “Bea”.
steps.see: The top-right button now says “Bea” instead of “Who are you?”.

steps.do: Scroll down to the “Paddock” card (TRASH TALK) and tap “Open the paddock →”.
steps.see: The Paddock opens: “Paddock · 5 in the room”, “Nobody has said anything yet.”, a box that says “Say it…” and a “Send” button.

steps.do: Leave the box empty and tap “Send”.
steps.see: Nothing is posted — it still says “Nobody has said anything yet.”

steps.do: Tap the “Say it…” box, type this (with the apostrophe) and tap “Send”.
steps.type: Cal's drivers need a tow truck! (example)
steps.see: Your message appears in the room under the name “BEA” with today’s date and time, the apostrophe looks right, and the box is empty again.

steps.do: Turn on Airplane Mode (swipe down from the top-right corner, tap ✈️). Type this in the box and tap “Send”.
steps.see: It still works with no internet: the second message appears under the first one, also from Bea.

steps.do: Turn Airplane Mode off. Then pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: Pit Wall opens on the home page, the top-right button still says “Bea”, and the Paddock card now shows both lines: “Bea: Cal's drivers need a tow truck! (example)” and “Bea: Margaret's pick wins Sunday (example)”.
steps.tip: A card “Keep Pit Wall on your Home Screen” may slide up — tap “Later”.

steps.do: Scroll to “TEST DRIVE · ACT AS” and tap “Alex”.
steps.see: The top-right button now says “Alex · commish” — Alex runs this pretend league.

steps.do: Scroll to the top and tap “Setup” in the gold pretend-league note.
steps.see: The Setup page: “You are the commissioner. Changes here apply to everyone.” and a list of sections such as Scoring, Rosters and “Players & league”.
It opens: a “League name” box that says “Pretend League”, the five players (Alex, Bea, Cal, Dana, Eli) each marked “playing”, and an “Add a player” box with an “Add” button.

steps.do: Leave the “Add a player” box empty and tap “Add”.
steps.see: Nothing happens — there are still five players.

steps.do: Tap the “Add a player” box, type this name and tap “Add”.
steps.see: A short note says “Player added”. The “Players & league” section folds shut.

steps.do: Tap “Players & league” again to open it.
steps.see: Six players now, with “Margaret O'Brien” last, spelled right and marked “playing”.

steps.do: Clear the “League name” box, type this new name and tap “Save league name”.
steps.see: A short note says “League name saved” and the line under “Pit Wall” at the top now reads “O'BRIEN FAMILY RACING (EXAMPLE) · 2026 · THIS DEVICE ONLY”.

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload it.
steps.see: The home page keeps the new league name at the top, the top-right button still says “Alex · commish”, and “TEST DRIVE · ACT AS” now has a sixth button, “Margaret O'Brien”.

steps.do: Tap “Margaret O'Brien” under “TEST DRIVE · ACT AS”.
steps.see: The top-right button now says “Margaret O'Brien”.
Your two trash-talk lines from Bea are still there, so everything you did today was kept.
